messages:
sarah-support: FYI customer escalation — streaming responses cut off after ~30s idle, client reconnects and only gets a small trailing chunk. They report duplicate tokens on resume and a billing spike. Raised for repro and engineering help.

mike-cs: Do we have an example request ID or minimal repro? They said traffic flows ALB -> Cloudflare -> our origin.

sarah-support: Customer sent repro steps. Environment: ALB (public) in front of Cloudflare, client is browser using an EventSource polyfill. Repro they run locally: 

```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" \\
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \\
  \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams?model=redwood-1\"
```

Observed behavior: first ~100 tokens stream normally, then silence for ~25-35s, connection closes, client reconnects and receives only the last ~8 tokens (partial). Server then continues and sometimes re-sends the same tokens, causing duplicates.

jon-oncall: Can you paste the X-Request-Id and any proxy connection ids from logs? Also what client does on reconnect (Last-Event-ID or resuming token index)?

sarah-support: Sanitzed logs from customer below. Note the ALB log line at close time: 

```
[2025-06-12T15:02:12Z] conn=abcd1234: keepalive tick
[2025-06-12T15:02:40Z] conn=abcd1234: no bytes from upstream
[2025-06-12T15:02:41Z] ALB idle-timeout triggered, closing connection
[2025-06-12T15:02:41Z] conn=abcd1234: server half-close
[2025-06-12T15:02:42Z] client reconnect, resumed, last-event-id=evt_9876
```

lina-frontend: Huh — ALB default idle is 60s, Cloudflare edge idle sometimes shorter depending on plan/policies. Could be an intermediate L7 (WAF, CDN buffer) enforcing a shorter silence timeout on streaming endpoints.

kevin-runtime: Two likely causes: 
1) Our runtime legitimately pauses sending bytes (e.g., waiting for tokenizer/LLM compute or cache hit) and the middlebox treats silence as dead socket and closes.
2) A proxy or CDN is buffering and then doing a half-close, so client reconnect resumes and we end up re-streaming the tail.

kevin-runtime: Immediate mitigations we can advise: 
- Send lightweight SSE heartbeats from the server every 10-15s (e.g., send ":hb\\n\\n") to keep proxies from idling the connection.
- Recommend ALB idle-timeout >= 120s for streaming paths.
- If using Cloudflare, turn off response buffering for that route or set Stream/Edge TTL appropriately.
- Client should send Last-Event-ID or equivalent token so server can dedupe on resume.

sarah-support: Customer also reported billing doubled because client reconnects cause re-generation of overlapping tokens. They want a faster fix than docs changes.

kevin-runtime: I'll open an internal engineering ticket to: add a per-route heartbeat toggle, implement server-side dedupe by last-event-id/session offset, and add a small instrumentation checkbox that emits a 15s heartbeat by default on hosted streaming routes. For now we should send the mitigation guidance.

jon-oncall: @eng-infra can you confirm if we have any ALB or Cloudflare rules that might close idle streaming sockets earlier than 60s? Also please share a minimal proxy chain repro (ALB+Cloudflare) so eng-runtime can reproduce. :eyes: 

sarah-support: Will do — updating the customer with the list of mitigations (heartbeat, ALB idle tweak, Cloudflare buffer off, client Last-Event-ID) and asking for full proxy logs + exact client UA. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
